frames.label: The EUR discount curve sells off through the belly
SOFR shifts up two basis points
The meeting dated curve reprices the front end
The EUR discount curve gaps again
The EURIBOR basis widens a basis point and a half
The ten year benchmark bond is bid
A bond off the curve is sold
Government bonds sell off three basis points
A benchmark bond's maturity arrives wrong
A coupon is keyed wrongly on a bond off the curve

bondScenarios.curveMove: The bond curve moves with the EUR discount curve plus a generated government to swap spread factor, parallel, 0.9bp a day times the regime multiple.
bondScenarios.spreadSource: Each bond with a residual history adds the day's change in its yield residual to its held z-spread, one basis point for one, recycled over the dated history; the other bonds take the curve move alone.

stressScenarios.name: Parallel +100bp
stressScenarios.note: Every curve up one hundred basis points at every tenor

stressScenarios.name: Parallel -100bp
stressScenarios.note: Every curve down one hundred basis points at every tenor

stressScenarios.name: Steepener
stressScenarios.note: Front end down 20bp at two years and in, long end up to +40bp at thirty years, on every curve

stressScenarios.name: Flattener
stressScenarios.note: The steepener reversed: front up 20bp, thirty years down to -40bp, on every curve

stressScenarios.name: Basis widening
stressScenarios.note: Projection basis up 15bp (EURIBOR) and cross currency bases up 25bp; discount curves unmoved

stressScenarios.name: Sovereign spread widening
stressScenarios.note: The government bond curve up fifty basis points at every tenor; every swap curve unmoved

stressScenarios.name: Swap spread tightening
stressScenarios.note: Every EUR swap curve down twenty five basis points at every tenor; the government bond curve unmoved
